## Key facts recovered (from Wikipedia)

- *Bullshit Jobs: A Theory* is a **2018 book by American anthropologist David Graeber** (Simon & Schuster, May 2018; 368 pp; ISBN 978-1-5011-4331-1).
- Postulates meaningless jobs cause psychological harm; contends **over half of societal work is pointless**.
- Defines a job as "bullshit" if society would be no worse off (or even notice) if it disappeared.
- Five classes of meaningless jobs: **flunkies, goons, duct tapers, box tickers, taskmasters**.
- Association of labor with virtuous suffering is recent; proposes **universal basic income** as a solution.
- Extension of Graeber's **2013 essay** "On the Phenomenon of Bullshit Jobs" (Strike! magazine), translated into 12 languages.
- YouGov poll: 37% of Britons felt their job didn't contribute "meaningfully."
- Criticism: two studies found <8% of European workers felt their job was useless; toxic work culture/bad management cited as better explanations.
